footnotes.text: **Shem MiShmuel, Chayei Sara 5:1-3 (5674)** (Chassidus) — Reads the same Zohar (I 129a) on the doubled hei, together with the cave as the gate of Gan Eden (I 127), as Machpelah joining the upper and lower hei, the upper and lower worlds; Rav Tzadok draws the same doubled hei toward the Ten Utterances and yirah. הנה מבואר שהיא דוגמא להתחברות שני ההין שבשם הוי בה יחד

**Mikdash Melekh on Zohar I 129a** (Kabbalah) — Explains why the Torah says "field of Machpelah": the field (lower hei) draws from the doubled hei, while to the sons of Heth Avraham spoke only of a "double cave". This is the Kabbalistic base of Rav Tzadok's doubled hei. וכשהתורה מספרת הענין אומרת שדה המכפלה לרמוז שהשדה שהוא גדול מהמערה יונק מהמ שנקראת מכפלה

**Zohar I 127b-128a (Chayei Sara)** (Kabbalah) — Just before "it had an actual rising", the Zohar says that Ephron saw nothing in the cave but darkness, because a thing is revealed only to its owner. This supports Rav Tzadok: while the sons of Heth held it, its holiness was captive. לְעֶפְרוֹן לָא הֲוַת אִתְגַּלְּיָא לֵיהּ דְּלָא הֲוָה לֵיהּ חוּלָקָא בֵּיהּ

**Midrash HaIttamari 27:12** (Machshava) — "And after that" Avraham buried Sarah: only once he had completed his tikkun did the field and cave "rise", redeemed from the impurity of the sons of Heth. This is close to Rav Tzadok's "after Avraham was made complete … then he bought it from them". ונתנה לאחוזת קבר לקדושים ופדאה מאת הטומאה מאת בני חת

footnotes.ref: Tanya, Part II; Shaar HaYichud VehaEmunah 1:9
footnotes.text: **Tanya, Shaar HaYichud VehaEmunah 1** (Chassidus) — A creature's name in the Holy Tongue is the vessel for the vitality drawn down to it from the Ten Utterances. Rav Tzadok makes the same move: the name is the root of vitality, and "ten" (the Utterances, the Commandments) is the complete measure. וְזֶה שְׁמוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִקְרְאוּ לוֹ בִּלְשׁוֹן הַקֹּדֶשׁ, הוּא כְּלִי לַחַיּוּת הַמְצוּמְצָם בְּאוֹתִיּוֹת שֵׁם זֶה

footnotes.ref: Likutei Halakhot, Choshen Mishpat, Laws of Gifting 4:11
footnotes.text: **Likutei Halakhot, Choshen Mishpat, Hilchos Matanah 4:11** (Chassidus) — Machpelah's great holiness was surrounded by the kelipos while it was in Ephron's hand, so it could not come out freely. Avraham's full payment broke them and "the field rose". This parallels Rav Tzadok's "captive among the sons of Heth" until Avraham drew the holiness out. וּכְשֶׁהָיְתָה תַּחַת יַד עֶפְרוֹן הָיוּ הַקְּלִפּוֹת מְסַבְּבִין אוֹתָהּ מְאֹד

**Be'er Mayim Chaim, Bereishis 23:16** (Chassidus) — Avraham would not bury Sarah while the field was still Ephron's, for holiness cannot rest under his domain. Once Avraham's name was on it, "the field rose". This is the same transfer from the sons of Heth to the tzaddik. כי כל עוד שרשות עפרון על השדה לא יוכל כל כך קדושת ה' לשרות בו בשום אופן
